newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Cosmos surges after China Resources deal.
newsitem.headline: Cosmos surges after China Resources deal.

text.p: Shares of Cosmos Machinery Enterprises Ltd surged after China Resources (Holdings) Co Ltd (CRC) agreed to take 24.3 percent of the company, brokers said.
"It (the news) was seen to have a positive impact both on the share price and the company's future earnings, and sitmulated many expectations," said Anthony Mak, sales director at Vickers Ballas.
Cosmos shares were up HK$0.68 or 51.9 percent at HK$1.99 in late morning after they hit an all-time high of HK$2.05.
Volume was 15.25 million shares worth HK$29.62 million.

"Speculation that China Resources will raise its stake in future by way of other asset injections, plus anticipation that the company will benefit from its tie with China Resources fueled buying," said a sales manager at regional brokerage.

Cosmos said on Monday that CRC, the parent of China Resources Enterprise Ltd, would take 24.3 percent of the company following Cosmos' purchase of a plastic machinery maker from a 49 percent owned unit of CRC for HK$272.9 million.
